Seawind Raheni is a Savage Seawind of Umberlee, found in Act Three.

Involvement

Raheni can be found in the Water Queen's Cellar in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Entangle ( + )

Vines sprout from the ground, turning it into  Difficult Terrain and possibly  Entangling creatures within.

Entangled creatures cannot move. An ally can use its help action to try and tear away the vines.

 STR Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Ice Knife ( + )
Damage: 3~22
1d10⁠Piercing

Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6Cold damage to anyone nearby. It leaves an  Ice surface. On miss, the shard of ice still explodes.

This spell can be cast while you are  Silenced.

Idle banter

Raheni occasionally chats with  Elonia and  Gira:

  • Dark Breaker Elonia
    So what was your Drowning like, then?
  • Seawind Raheni
    A salty breeze.
  • Seawind Raheni
    Swallowed a load of water, woke up with the Flood Tide standing over me. Done.
  • Seawind Raheni
    How about yours?
  • Dark Breaker Gira
    Started to panic, didn't I? Took three waveservants to hold me under.
  • Dark Breaker Gira
    Don't think they would've minded if I didn't wake up afterwards.
  • Dark Breaker Gira
    Too bad for them I did.
  • Dark Breaker Elonia
    Ah, but it was worth it in the end, wasn't it?
  • Dark Breaker Gira
    Oh, aye - me and the Bitch Queen are best mates now.
  • Dark Breaker Gira
    She's just a demanding lady. But so am I.
  • Seawind Raheni
    Ain't that the truth?
  • Dark Breaker Gira
    Watch it, you - there's no guarantee Umberlee'll save you from a second drowning.
  • Dark Breaker Elonia
    We can only hope.
  • Seawind Raheni
    All right, you two - I get it. I'll behave.
